smoke.description: 60s check that everything works, with 4 query workers and 500 KV ops/s

query-ramp.description: ramps from 1 to 32 query workers over 5 minutes, to find where latency starts to climb

query-spike.description: 20 q/s baseline with 10s spikes to 100 q/s every minute

cancel-storm.description: cancels 30% of queries mid-flight, then runs every query again to check if a collection has been left broken
cancel-storm.notes: Look for post-check failures, and pinCount or unavailable collection errors in analytics_error.log afterwards.

kv-outage.description: queries and ingestion whilst the source KV is frozen for 2 minutes
kv-outage.notes: Check that Analytics queries keep working (they should), and how long the ingestion lag takes to recover.

rollback.description: high write rate, then kills the source twice so unpersisted mutations are lost (DCP rollback)
rollback.notes: Check analytics_info.log for rollback messages, and that the lag and gap go back to around 0 after each restart.

relink-recreate.description: drops and recreates the source bucket during ingestion
relink-recreate.notes: The writers get errors whilst the bucket is gone. Afterwards the analytics collection should sync up with the contents of the new bucket.

compressed-dcp.description: source bucket with active compression, and large compressible docs at a high write rate
compressed-dcp.notes: Compare the CBAS heap and node memory in the report with the KV DCP ready queue stats on the source. Needs a new collection name, so that the bucket is created with active compression.

merge-pressure.description: constant heavy upserts over a small keyspace, to cause columnar merges on object storage
merge-pressure.notes: EA only. Look out for node restarts or recovery in the events and the server health metrics.

schema-drift.description: 10% of ingested docs change shape (missing, extra or retyped fields) under query load

rebalance-under-load.description: rebalances the EA cluster whilst queries and ingestion run. Add a node first, e.g. ea_repro.py up --nodes 2, as a rebalance with no change in nodes moves very little

node-restart.description: restarts an EA node during the run, to see how queries and ingestion recover
